name: Wayward Children
overview: Scripture reveals that wayward children are those who turn away from God's commandments despite His loving call to return, as seen in Jeremiah's plea to backsliding children to come back to the Lord. The foundation for steadfastness begins with diligent training in the way of the Lord during youth, promising that such instruction will prevent departure in later life. God’s desire is for His people to walk pleasingly before Him, which brings peace even with adversaries, and He graciously offers healing and restoration to those who repent and return to Him.
